## file-1.fut hibák:

- 31. sor: `let ii' = if swap then (ii with [a] = ii[b], [b] = ii[a]) else ii` - Helytelen szintaxis, a tuple és a with kifejezés kombinációja érvénytelen
- 32. sor: `let ss' = if swap then (ss with [a] = ss[b], [b] = ss[a]) else ss` - Helytelen szintaxis, azonos hiba mint az előző sorban
- 35. sor: `loop st = (ids', scores') for i in 0 .. < (k-1) do` - A `for i in 0 .. < (k-1)` helytelen Futhark szintaxis, `for i < k-1` formátum szükséges
- 43. sor: `let folder (st: ([kk]doc_id, [kk]f32)) (pair: (f32, doc_id)) =` - A `reduce` nem használható nem-kommutatív műveletekkel, `fold` vagy `scan` szükséges helyette
- 47. sor: `let (ids_asc, scores_asc) = reduce folder (init_ids, init_scores) (zip scores_in ids_in)` - Helytelen `reduce` használat nem-kommutatív operátorral
- 48-51. sor: A függvény nem kommutatív, ezért a `reduce` nem adja vissza a helyes eredményt

## file-2.fut hibák:

- 14. sor: `let ii = f32.i` - Helytelen típuskonverzió, `f32.i64 i` szükséges
- 15. sor: `f32.d` - A méret paraméter helytelen konverziója, `f32.i64 d` szükséges
- 15. sor: `pow 10000f32 ((2f32 * floor (ii/2f32)) / f32.d)` - A `f32.d` helytelen

## file-3.fut hibák:

- 28. sor: `let loop (iter: i64, cent: [k][n]f32) =` - Helytelen Futhark szintaxis, a `loop` nem függvény definiálható így
- 29-40. sor: Az egész függvénydefiníció helytelen struktúrájú
- 38. sor: `loop (iter+1i64) cent2` - Helytelen függvényhívás szintaxis
- 39. sor: `loop 0i64 cent0` - Helytelen függvényhívás szintaxis

## file-4.fut hibák:

- 22. sor: `let pooled = map (\\x -> reduce (map2 (+)) (replicate d 0f32) x) pairs` - A `reduce (map2 (+))` helytelen szintaxis, a `reduce_comm` vagy megfelelő redukciós operátor szükséges

## file-5.fut hibák:

- 26. sor: `let idx = iota m` majd `let pairs = zip scores (map i64 idx)` - A `map i64 idx` redundáns, az `iota` már `i64` típust ad vissza
- 27. sor: `let sorted = sort_by (\\(s,i) -> -s) pairs` - Az unáris mínusz nem működik közvetlenül `f32`-en a kulcs függvényben, negatív sorrendhez `(\\(s1,_) (s2,_) -> s2 > s1)` komparátor szükséges a `sort`-hoz
- 28. sor: `take k (map snd sorted)` - Ha `k > m`, akkor hiba léphet fel
- 33. sor: `let idx = top_k_idx (k+1i64) row` - Típushiba: `top_k_idx` visszatérési típusa `[k]i64`, de itt `k+1` elemet kérünk
- 34. sor: `let filtered = filter (\\i -> i != 0i64) (map (\\j -> j - 0i64) idx)` - A `j - 0i64` művelet értelmetlen
- 35. sor: `take k filtered` - Ha `filtered` hossza kisebb mint `k`, futási hiba

```futhark
type doc_id = i64

let dot [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) a b)

let norm [n] (a: [n]f32) : f32 =
  sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\x -> x*x) a))

let normalize [n] (a: [n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let na = norm a
  if na == 0f32 then a else map (\\x -> x/na) a

let cosine_similarity [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  let aa = normalize a
  let bb = normalize b
  dot aa bb

let batch_cosine [m][n] (query: [n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) : [m]f32 =
  let qn = normalize query
  map (\\d -> dot qn (normalize d)) docs

let insert_topk [k] (ids: [k]doc_id) (scores: [k]f32) (id: doc_id) (s: f32) : ([k]doc_id, [k]f32) =
  if s <= scores[0] then (ids, scores) else
    let ids' = ids with [0] = id
    let scores' = scores with [0] = s
    let (ids'', scores'') = loop (ii, ss) = (ids', scores') for i < k-1 do
      let a = i
      let b = i + 1
      let swap = ss[a] > ss[b]
      let ii' = if swap then (ii with [a] = ii[b]) with [b] = ii[a] else ii
      let ss' = if swap then (ss with [a] = ss[b]) with [b] = ss[a] else ss
      in (ii', ss')
    in (ids'', scores'')

let top_k [m] (k_in: i64) (scores_in: [m]f32) (ids_in: [m]doc_id) : ([]doc_id, []f32) =
  let k = if k_in < 0i64 then 0i64 else if k_in > i64.m then i64.m else k_in
  in if k == 0i64 then ([], []) else
    let kk = i32.i64 k
    let init_ids = replicate kk 0i64
    let init_scores = replicate kk (-3.4e38f32)
    let (ids_asc, scores_asc) = loop (acc_ids, acc_scores) = (init_ids, init_scores) for i < m do
      let (new_ids, new_scores) = insert_topk acc_ids acc_scores ids_in[i] scores_in[i]
      in (new_ids, new_scores)
    let ids = reverse ids_asc
    let ss = reverse scores_asc
    in (map i64.i32 ids, ss)

entry search [m][n] (query: [n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) (ids: [m]doc_id) (k: i64) : ([]doc_id, []f32) =
  let scores = batch_cosine query docs
  in top_k k scores ids

entry batch_search [q][m][n] (queries: [q][n]f32) (docs: [m][n]f32) (ids: [m]doc_id) (k: i64) : [q]([]doc_id, []f32) =
  map (\\qq -> search qq docs ids k) queries

let top_nprobe_centroids [c][n] (query: [n]f32) (centroids: [c][n]f32) (nprobe: i64) : []i64 =
  let scores = batch_cosine query centroids
  let idx = iota c
  let (ii, _) = top_k nprobe scores idx
  in ii

entry ivf_search [c][n][m] (query: [n]f32) (centroids: [c][n]f32) (doc_ids: [m]doc_id) (doc_vecs: [m][n]f32) (assignments: [m]i64) (nprobe: i64) (k: i64) : ([]doc_id, []f32) =
  let probes = top_nprobe_centroids query centroids nprobe
  let mask = map (\\a -> any (\\p -> p == a) probes) assignments
  let cand_ids = compress mask doc_ids
  let cand_vecs = compress mask doc_vecs
  let scores = batch_cosine query cand_vecs
  in top_k k scores cand_ids
```

```futhark
entry pad_sequences [b] (lengths: [b]i64) (max_len: i64) : [b][max_len]i64 =
  map (\\l ->
    let ll = if l < 0i64 then 0i64 else if l > max_len then max_len else l
    let seq = iota ll
    let pad = replicate (max_len - ll) 0i64
    in concat seq pad
  ) lengths

entry create_attention_masks [b][t] (tokens: [b][t]i64) : [b][t]i64 =
  map (\\row -> map (\\x -> if x == 0i64 then 0i64 else 1i64) row) tokens

entry positional_encoding [t][d] (positions: [t]f32) : [t][d]f32 =
  map (\\p ->
    map (\\i ->
      let ii = f32.i64 i
      let dd = f32.i64 d
      let denom = f32.pow 10000f32 ((2f32 * f32.floor (ii / 2f32)) / dd)
      in if (i % 2) == 0 then f32.sin (p / denom) else f32.cos (p / denom)
    ) (iota d)
  ) positions

entry layer_norm [b][d] (x: [b][d]f32) (eps: f32) : [b][d]f32 =
  map (\\row ->
    let dd = f32.i64 d
    let mu = (reduce (+) 0f32 row) / dd
    let var = (reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\v -> let dv = v - mu in dv * dv) row)) / dd
    let inv = 1f32 / f32.sqrt (var + eps)
    in map (\\v -> (v - mu) * inv) row
  ) x
```

```futhark
let l2sq [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (\\x y -> let d = x - y in d * d) a b)

let argmin [m] (xs: [m]f32) : i64 =
  let idx = iota m
  let pairs = zip xs idx
  let sorted = sort_by (\\(v1, _) (v2, _) -> v1 < v2) pairs
  in snd sorted[0]

let mean_vec [m][n] (xs: [m][n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let sums = reduce (map2 (+)) (replicate n 0f32) xs
  let mm = f32.i64 m
  in map (\\x -> x / mm) sums

let update_centroids [k][m][n] (points: [m][n]f32) (assign: [m]i64) : [k][n]f32 =
  let idx = iota k
  in map (\\c ->
    let mask = map (\\a -> a == c) assign
    let chosen = filter (\\i -> mask[i]) (iota m)
    let chosen_points = map (\\i -> points[i]) chosen
    in if length chosen_points == 0 then points[0] else mean_vec chosen_points
  ) idx

entry assign_to_clusters [k][m][n] (centroids: [k][n]f32) (points: [m][n]f32) : [m]i64 =
  map (\\p ->
    let dists = map (\\c -> l2sq p c) centroids
    in argmin dists
  ) points

entry kmeans [k][m][n] (points: [m][n]f32) (max_iter: i64) (tolerance: f32) : ([k][n]f32, [m]i64) =
  let cent0 = take k points
  let (final_cent, final_asg) = loop (iter, cent) = (0i64, cent0) while iter < max_iter do
    let asg = assign_to_clusters cent points
    let cent2 = update_centroids points asg
    let delta = reduce (+) 0f32 (flatten (map2 (\\a b -> map2 (\\x y -> let d = x - y in d * d) a b) cent cent2))
    in if delta <= tolerance then (cent2, asg) else (iter + 1i64, cent2)
  let final_asg_computed = assign_to_clusters final_cent points
  in (final_cent, final_asg_computed)

entry build_ivf_index [k][m] (assign: [m]i64) (doc_ids: [m]i64) : [k][]i64 =
  let idx = iota k
  in map (\\c ->
    let mask = map (\\a -> a == c) assign
    let indices = filter (\\i -> mask[i]) (iota m)
    in map (\\i -> doc_ids[i]) indices
  ) idx
```

```futhark
let softmax [n] (xs: [n]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let m = reduce f32.max (-1.0e30f32) xs
  let exps = map (\\x -> f32.exp (x - m)) xs
  let s = reduce (+) 0f32 exps
  in map (\\x -> x / s) exps

let matmul [m][k][n] (a: [m][k]f32) (b: [k][n]f32) : [m][n]f32 =
  map (\\row ->
    map (\\j ->
      reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) row (map (\\r -> r[j]) b))
    ) (iota n)
  ) a

let attention [t][d] (q: [t][d]f32) (k: [t][d]f32) (v: [t][d]f32) : [t][d]f32 =
  let kt = transpose k
  let scores = matmul q kt
  let dd = f32.i64 d
  let scale = 1f32 / f32.sqrt dd
  let scaled = map (map (\\x -> x * scale)) scores
  let weights = map softmax scaled
  in matmul weights v

entry rerank_transformer [n][t][d] (pairs: [n][t][d]f32) : [n]f32 =
  let pooled = map (\\x -> reduce_comm (map2 (+)) (replicate d 0f32) x) pairs
  let norms = map (\\x -> f32.sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\y -> y * y) x))) pooled
  let normed = map2 (\\x nrm -> if nrm == 0f32 then x else map (\\y -> y / nrm) x) pooled norms
  let w = replicate d 1f32
  in map (\\x -> reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) x w)) normed
```

```futhark
let dot [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (*) a b)

let norm [n] (a: [n]f32) : f32 =
  f32.sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map (\\x -> x * x) a))

let cosine [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  let na = norm a
  let nb = norm b
  in if na == 0f32 || nb == 0f32 then 0f32 else (dot a b) / (na * nb)

let euclidean [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  f32.sqrt (reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (\\x y -> let d = x - y in d * d) a b))

let manhattan [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  reduce (+) 0f32 (map2 (\\x y -> f32.abs (x - y)) a b)

let angular_distance [n] (a: [n]f32) (b: [n]f32) : f32 =
  let c = f32.max (-1f32) (f32.min 1f32 (cosine a b))
  in (f32.acos c) / f32.pi

entry pairwise_cosine [q][m][d] (queries: [q][d]f32) (docs: [m][d]f32) : [q][m]f32 =
  map (\\qq -> map (\\dd -> cosine qq dd) docs) queries

let top_k_idx [m] (k: i64) (scores: [m]f32) : []i64 =
  let kk = if k < 0i64 then 0i64 else if k > m then m else k
  let idx = iota m
  let pairs = zip scores idx
  let sorted = sort_by (\\(s1, _) (s2, _) -> s2 < s1) pairs
  in take kk (map snd sorted)

entry build_knn_graph [m][d] (embs: [m][d]f32) (k: i64) : [m][]i64 =
  let sims = pairwise_cosine embs embs
  in map (\\i ->
    let row = sims[i]
    let idx = top_k_idx (k + 1i64) row
    let filtered = filter (\\j -> j != i) idx
    in take k filtered
  ) (iota m)
```
